name: Weekly company hiring digest to Slack (ATS Job Changes Feed)

parameters.content:
## Weekly hiring digest per company → Slack
For investors, analysts and account teams: one message a week with open roles and new/closed roles per company, from the Actor's free `company` summary records.
1. **Run ATS Job Changes Feed**: Header Auth credential (`Authorization` = `Bearer <your Apify token>`), edit `companies`.
2. **Post to Slack**: your incoming-webhook URL.

Each run is charged per company board read and per changed job delivered; unchanged jobs are free.

nodes.name: Run ATS Job Changes Feed
nodes.notes: Credential: Header Auth, name 'Authorization', value 'Bearer <your Apify API token>'. Keep monitorId unchanged between runs: it is the memory that makes each run return only changes. maxTotalChargeUsd caps what one run can cost.

nodes.name: Post to Slack
nodes.notes: Replace the URL with your own Slack incoming-webhook URL.
